Recorder

Record it once.

Use the site in a real browser. Every click, keystroke and check lands as a step — with its screenshot, and every way Tracemend found to reach the element, ranked by how reliable it is.

  • Clicks, typing, checks and waits
  • Branches, loops and reusable flows
  • Data from CSV or JSON
  • Variables and secrets kept apart
Tracemend

Self-healing

When the page moves, the test follows.

Each step keeps its ranked locators. When the one in use stops matching, Tracemend finds the same element by similarity, carries on, and asks you to keep or reject the move — recorded and found, side by side.

Tracemend

Generated code

Your framework. Your language.

Export Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or WebdriverIO in TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java or C# — with page objects, Gherkin, a CI pipeline, an Allure or JUnit report, and the healing resolver built into the code.

Tracemend

Runs

See exactly where it broke.

Every run keeps each step’s status, time and picture. A failed check says what it expected and what the page had, on the screen it happened on.

Tracemend

Compare runs

What changed since yesterday?

Put two runs side by side — outcome, steps, time, the screen they ran on — and open both pictures of any step.

Tracemend

Phones and tablets

Desktop. iPhone. Pixel. iPad.

Record and replay on seven screens, emulated with Playwright’s own descriptors — or run every test on several at once and compare them.

Tracemend

Accessibility

Tests that audit as they go.

Turn on accessibility checks and every screen a test reaches is scanned for WCAG 2.2 A and AA problems — each ringed on the step’s picture, with how to fix it.

Tracemend

Assistant

Ask why it failed.

The Assistant reads the run on screen and answers from your project — the failed step, the likely cause, a steadier locator — with a button that does it. It works offline.

Tracemend

CI

Run it headless.

tracemend --cli run runs the same suite on your runner — workers, shards, retries and tags — with JUnit or JSON for your pipeline, and exit code 1 when a test fails.

Which one do you need?

Three tools, three jobs. All free, all on your own computer.

  • Driftly

    Know if a release is safe to ship.

    Watches your live sites — visual changes, security, speed and APIs — and gives one GO or NO-GO before each release. Its recorder replays a few key flows inside those checks.

    Meet Driftly

  • TracemendYou’re here

    Build the test suite you keep.

    Turns flows you record into Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or WebdriverIO code your team owns — with page objects, accessibility checks, phones and tablets, and a CLI for CI — and keeps it healing as the site changes.

  • Prism

    Test your API, flow by flow.

    A workspace for API testing: requests chained into flows, checks on every response, load tests, a mock server and code in 15 formats — with a command-line runner for CI.

    Meet Prism

How to verify your download

Compute the SHA-256 of the file

Get-FileHash "$HOME\Downloads\Tracemend Setup 1.0.0.exe" -Algorithm SHA256

Compute the SHA-256 of the file

shasum -a 256 ~/Downloads/"Tracemend Setup 1.0.0.exe"

Compute the SHA-256 of the file

shasum -a 256 ~/Downloads/"Tracemend Setup 1.0.0.exe"
# or: sha256sum ~/Downloads/"Tracemend Setup 1.0.0.exe"

Compare the result with the SHA-256 published next to the file. If they differ, delete the file and download it again.

What’s new in 1.0.0

v1.0.020 Oct 2026
  • First public release, for Windows 10 and 11 (x64).
  • Record in a real browser: every step with its screenshot and ranked locators, pinned on the page it happened on.
  • Self-healing replay, with every move kept for you to accept or reject on Heals.
  • Generated code for Playwright, Selenium, Cypress and WebdriverIO in five languages — with page objects, Gherkin, a CI pipeline and the healing resolver.
  • Runs with workers, shards and retries; schedules; side-by-side run comparison.
  • Accessibility checks (WCAG 2.2 A and AA) and phone and tablet emulation.
  • The Assistant: answers from your project and the fixes they point to, offline.
  • tracemend --cli run for CI, with JUnit and JSON reports.
  • Automatic updates are off until you turn them on in Settings.
